attributes.name: Stone Golem
attributes.powers:
The Stone Golem is immune to the Attack and Mental traits.

If undefeated, each character at your location is dealt 1d4-1 Combat damage; do not reset your hand at the end of the turn.

As this ponderous golem inexorably advances, you'll only hear the sound of grinding stone.
